title: Where the storefront sits
caption: One static build in `/srv/velexis/current/storefront` serves every OTA. The host name picks the tenant; every booking function is an OTA API call on the same origin (`/api/*`), made by the SDK in cookie mode. Locally the Vite dev proxy plays Caddy's part.

nodes.label: Traveller
nodes.detail: A **visitor**, a **guest** (holds the `__Host-vx_bt` booking cookie) or a signed-in **customer** (`__Host-vx_at` / `__Host-vx_rt`).

nodes.label: OTA staff
nodes.detail: Change branding, features, markups, content pages and the airline-card switch in the OTA admin; the storefront sees the change within about 5 minutes (storefront.get cache).

nodes.label: Caddy (prod)
nodes.detail: `<key>.ota.example.com` and verified custom domains (on-demand TLS). Serves `dist/`, rewrites `/p/*` to `p.html`, strips `/api` and adds `X-Velexis-Edge` + `X-Velexis-Host`. CSP and other headers from `deploy/caddy/Caddyfile`.

nodes.label: Vite dev proxy (local)
nodes.detail: `pnpm --filter @velexis/ota-frontend dev` on http://localhost:5173 (or `preview` on 4173). Sends `STOREFRONT_DEV_HOST` (default `demo.ota.example.com`) as `X-Velexis-Host` and as `Origin`.

nodes.label: Static pages + ES modules
nodes.detail: 20 HTML pages (`ota/frontend/*.html`), Tailwind CSS 4, one entry module per page in `src/pages/`, `boot()` on every page except the airline-card page.

nodes.label: @velexis/ota-sdk (cookie mode)
nodes.detail: `createVelexisClient({ baseUrl: "/api", session: "cookie" })` in `src/lib/client.js`. Copies `__Host-vx_csrf` into `X-CSRF-Token` on writes, refreshes once on `401 TOKEN_EXPIRED`.

nodes.label: Stripe.js
nodes.detail: Loaded by `/checkout/pay-card.html` only (static `<script src="https://js.stripe.com/v3/">`). Card data stays inside Stripe's iframes.

nodes.label: OTA API :4000
nodes.detail: Resolves the host to the tenant and its storefront environment, checks CSRF and rate limits, answers every `/v1/*` call. Writes only through `tenantTx`.

nodes.label: OTA admin
nodes.detail: Storefront settings, pages, assets, markups, fees; staff work the bookings the storefront creates.

nodes.label: platform schema (read only)
nodes.detail: `platform.tenants` (status, `storefront_environment`), `platform.tenant_domains` (host → tenant), connections. The OTA API reads them through cached views; it never writes them.

nodes.label: Redis
nodes.detail: `t:<tenantId>:<env>:sf:<locale>` (storefront.get), `host:<hostname>` / `tenantkey:<key>` caches, `rl:ota_*` rate limits, `t:…:cxq:<bookingId>` quotes, `t:…:ac:*` airline-card attempts, BullMQ queues (prefix `vx`).

nodes.label: Amadeus (stub :4900 locally)
nodes.detail: Flight Offers Search / Price, Branded Fares Upsell, Flight Create Orders, Order Management. Locally `pnpm stub:amadeus`.

nodes.label: Stripe
nodes.detail: PaymentIntents with manual capture; webhooks to the OTA API; test mode locally with `tools/dev/stripe-listen.sh`.

nodes.label: SMTP / Mailpit :8025
nodes.detail: Verification, password reset, booking confirmed / updated / cancelled, ticketed e-mails. Locally http://localhost:8025.
